title: Morphisms in $D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ descend to a finite extension
statement:
Let $X$ be a standing scheme, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite and $C,D\in\Dbc(X,E)$. For finite
$F\supseteq E$ and every $r\in\mathbf Z$:

1. $\Hom_{D(X,F)}(C_F,D_F[r])\cong\Hom_{D(X,E)}(C,\operatorname{Res}D_F[r])$, and likewise over $\Qlb$,
   naturally in $F$;
2. if $D^\bullet$ is a bounded complex representing $D$, then $(D^\bullet\otimes_{E_X}F_X)_F$ is a
   filtered system of complexes of $E_X$-modules vanishing below the lower bound of $D^\bullet$,
   with colimit $D^\bullet\otimes_{E_X}\QbarX$;
3. the map $\varinjlim_F\Hom(C_F,D_F[r])\to\Hom(C_{\Qlb},D_{\Qlb}[r])$ is bijective.

proof.text: The finite and algebraic-closure Hom maps are the recorded adjunction equivalences, hence bijective. For any compositional comparison, naturality of homEquiv on its left argument and its counit inverse formula prove the two stated coefficient-naturality equations. This argument uses the actual definitions, without reconstructing their adjunctions.

The coefficient tail Under E is filtered, as is its universe lift. Its forgetful functor to finite coefficient fields is final. Apply the existing coefficient-complex colimit theorem. Additive scalar extension and restriction carry every zero term below the original bound to zero.

The standing finite-type scheme is Noetherian. The bounded-constructible property over E is triangulated, so replace D by D[r]. Apply the existing constructibleCocone_homSurj proof from the source-library two-colimit theorem to C and D[r]. That theorem proves the required finite representative by the coefficient complex presentation, single-sheaf Ext continuity and triangulated devissage. Unpack fullness of bounded constructible categories. The exact derived scalar multiplication comparison commutes with shifts, so conjugating by the shift comparisons gives precisely the specified shifted Hom extension. This reuses the unit route through coefficient colimits and Ext continuity.

The generic shifted Hom transport composes along coherent tensor comparisons; prove this by naturality, shift compatibility and cancelling inverse isomorphisms. Apply the algebraic-closure associativity clause of the existing proved condensedCoefficientCoherence theorem; the standing scheme supplies its Noetherian hypothesis. For two representatives agreeing over the closure, choose a common finite extension H. Their transitions have equal images over the closure by the composition identity. Extension from H to the closure is faithful, and conjugating by the tensor and shift isomorphisms is injective, so the transitioned morphisms are equal already at H.
